answer: Each new agent must lock 250 POA for 28 epochs and gain endorsements from five established agents, each staking 25 POA slashed if the newcomer cheats. A second identity from the same funding source must lock 1000 POA, a third 2250 POA, so cost rises quadratically and a farm cannot cheaply echo one credential across many accounts. A fraudulent signal triggers a ripple of peer checks of funding, endorsements and past attestations, slashing linked bonds. Only identities passing three attestation rounds without dispute earn rewards.
